name: Eni
note: Reviewed 2026-10-06 (#183). Ownership link now sourced and quote-checked (Eni 2026 AGM filing; Eni Form 20-F FY2025 Item 7: MEF 2.166% direct plus 30.918% via Cassa Depositi e Prestiti, itself 82.77% MEF-owned; the 20-F states the MEF controls Eni). The concern tier proposed in the PR was rejected by review: a tier needs a qualifying record - Italy has no sourced record of serious abuses covered by METHOD.md (state ownership alone is not a tier; the part-state precedents cited, lenovo/noon/g42 etc., are states with such records), and the Greenpeace/ReCommon suit is pending and is a climate claim, which the method excludes. Unresolved company-record question for a maintainer (oil-and-gas major test): the same 20-F (commitments and contingencies, F-90/F-91) discloses Italian administrative-court rulings of May 2024 and 27 December 2024 confirming Eni Rewind (EniChem successor) as responsible for pollution at the Trissino site, where the Province of Vicenza reported toxic and carcinogenic substances in the blood of about 53,000 people; not yet assessed or claimed against the company-record test.
